evidence.t: Road: Gaspard Churn FSR, 5.2 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
9 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
8 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 159 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.28343, -122.71725, pull off on Gaspard Red Mountain FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 200 m to the start. Walk: the Gaspard Churn FSR stretch, 5.2 km one way. About 104 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-3, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-07, closures 2026-10-16.
